BufferJournalEntry: named but never specified in the source pack — designed here per the WP-1 task brief's explicit instruction, under the common envelope conventions (FB-RAT-COM-002 identity is deliberately NOT re-declared per-entry; identity for an append-only log entry is its (bufferId, sequence) pair, not a separate objectId — see WORKSPACE_KERNEL_SPEC.md §7). This is WorkspaceJournal.append()'s parameter shape (FB-RAT-WS-005: human and agent edits share ONE transaction/journal/review/undo/conflict model — `originKind` is how that single stream stays legible about which lane produced a given entry, not a second write path).
title: BufferJournalEntry

sequence.description: Monotonic sequence number for this entry, scoped to the owning WorkspaceJournal (FB-RAT-COM-004 — monotonic sequence preferred over wall-clock for ordering). Readers MUST detect a gap between a buffer's DocumentBuffer.journalSequence and the next entry it reads as a possible torn/lost append (see fixtures/workspace/adversarial/buffer-journal-forced-kill-mid-append.adversarial.json).

opType.description: The edit or lifecycle operation this entry records. INSERT/DELETE/REPLACE are byte-range text edits; SET_FULL_CONTENT replaces the whole buffer (e.g. an external reformat or a restored snapshot); OPEN/CLOSE/DISCARD are lifecycle markers with no content payload.

oneOf.description: Half-open [startByte, endByteExclusive) range this edit applies to, in the buffer's byte-offset space at the time of this entry. A reader MUST treat endByteExclusive < startByte as malformed (not structurally rejected here — JSON Schema 2020-12 has no cross-property comparison keyword without a `$data` extension this constellation does not depend on).

byteRange.description: Non-null only for INSERT/DELETE/REPLACE; null for SET_FULL_CONTENT/OPEN/CLOSE/DISCARD (structurally enforced below).

content.description: The literal text this entry inserts/replaces-with, or the full buffer content for SET_FULL_CONTENT. Null for DELETE (nothing inserted) and for OPEN/CLOSE/DISCARD (no content payload). Non-null required for INSERT/REPLACE/SET_FULL_CONTENT (structurally enforced below).

recordedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this entry was recorded (FB-RAT-COM-004). `sequence`, not this field, is authoritative for ordering.

originKind.description: Which lane produced this edit (FB-RAT-WS-005 — a single unified journal covers both; this field is how the one stream stays legible about provenance, not a signal that a second write path exists).

originPrincipal.description: Identifier of the specific human or agent principal that produced this entry (FB-RAT-COM-008 provenance minimum — initiating principal), e.g. a user id or an agent/run id.

unknownFields.description: Bag for fields a decoder received but did not recognize, preserved for round-trip (FB-RAT-COM-003).
